build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the @define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE physics task
create_dynamic_boxes_with_add_box: use C.add_box to create dynamic box bodies with specified width and height in the scene
position_bodies_with_set_bottom_set_left: use set_bottom and set_left methods to position bodies at specific coordinates in the scene
define_task_goal_with_update_task: use C.update_task to assign body1 and body2 targets and specify spatial relationship goals
set_spatial_relationship_touching: use C.SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING to define a task where two bodies must touch each other
